timing_definitions.agent_reported_api_seconds: Provider/agent-CLI reported API duration when present in structured output; null otherwise.
timing_definitions.agent_timeout_limit_seconds: Frozen limit passed to the agent component; metadata only and never substituted for the measured end-to-end elapsed-time observation.
timing_definitions.cell_setup_wall_seconds: Harness monotonic wall time from cell start until the agent interval begins.
timing_definitions.cell_total_wall_seconds: Harness monotonic wall time for setup, agent execution, validation, and record assembly.
timing_definitions.end_to_end_user_visible_wall_seconds: Harness monotonic wall time immediately before harness-owned treatment retrieval/delivery (a no-op at the same logical point for no-memory) through agent CLI completion, or through the immediately observed treatment-failure / timeout-termination boundary when no final response exists. The boundary is captured before usage parsing, hashing, and artifact writes. Worktree/cache setup, secret preflight, and hidden validation are excluded.
timing_definitions.harness_agent_interval_wall_seconds: Harness monotonic wall time immediately around the agent CLI invocation. Confirmatory provider retries are frozen at zero; exploratory retries and backoff remain included. Setup, cache prewarm, and validation are excluded.
timing_definitions.timeout_component_limit_seconds: Exact limit of the retrieval/delivery or agent component that raised TimeoutExpired; null when no component timed out and never substituted for measured end-to-end elapsed time.
